BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, yêm is the word for a warm spring. In Genesis 36:24, this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: What strikes me is that Anah found yêm in the wilderness, and I hold that God hides provision in the places we least expect.
